name: Pacify the Centaur
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details: adventurer, I entreat you to hunt these centaur down. They shall feel the wrath of our revenge. Attack the centaur camp to the north of Freewind Post!  Let wrath guide your hand!
narrative.objectives: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.
narrative.offerRewardText: For my gratitude, this is for you, adventurer.
narrative.requestItemsText: Come now adventurer, I know you haven't killed your share yet. Hunt them down, and I shall give you a reward for my gratitude.

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 25 to 28, 4,800 XP in all.
